answer: Seed a memory-hard eligibility puzzle with the epoch beacon, the account public key, and fresh words such as marble, raven, timber. Each earning key must present a verifiable solution before rewards open. Binding work to the key stops one solution being reused by aliases; changing the beacon each epoch stops advance stockpiling. A farm with k keys must perform k separate memory-intensive searches, renting RAM and paying electricity for each, while renaming an old key gives no free proof.
